notes.title: QoL Update
notes.content:
Unpogable got updated to version 1.23.05.04.2. Here's what's new:


+ Added respawn mechanic. Hold 'R' or the back buttons on a controller to respawn. This acts like a normal death so be careful when to use it! Definitely not adviced to use in the Ultimate Challenge Level. This also gets explained in the tutorial at the beginning of the level

+ The bouncy, slippery and physic level elements got a new model. You can now distinguish them from other elements even when assigning them the same skin. With that each element has now a unique shape. Still cubes but unique cubes

= Fixed the UI on non 16:9 monitors
= Fixed bugs related to the camera zoom that happens when falling down
= Changed the opacity of the settings and result menus for better visibility of the content
= More minor bug fixes


That's it for this update! I hope you're all having fun beating the Ultimate Challenge Level and Daily Levels. Don't give up, you can do this!
